title: Pricing Briefs & Onboarding Storyboards for Catalog Release — visual assets for new model entry and deprecation flows
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Produce a concise set of visual assets and annotated storyboards for the catalog release that cover two core flows: 1) new model entry (hero + quickstart screenshots + onboarding overlay) and 2) deprecation messaging (banner + modal + release-note screenshots). These assets will be used in the public release notes, in-console onboarding quickstart, and the model detail page.

Deliverables (scope):
- High-fidelity screenshot set for new model tile (desktop & mobile widths) with price badges (cost per 1k tokens & embedding unit), latency callouts, and call-to-action variations (Try / Pin version / View changelog).
- Storyboard sequence (5 frames) showing onboarding microcopy for first-time use of a newly added model: welcome message, recommended prompt templates, cost estimator overlay, and one-step sample request.
- Deprecation flow assets: in-console banner (compact + expanded), deprecation modal (confirm-switch CTA + migration link), and two screenshot sizes for release notes. Tone variants: neutral informational copy vs. proactive migration copy (A/B test).
- Annotated export (PNG/SVG) for engineering handoff describing padding, font sizes, badge color tokens, and i18n keys.
- Accessible color contrast verification and alt-text drafts for each asset.

Acceptance criteria:
- All screenshots exported at 2x for retina and provided in 1200px and 680px widths.
- Figma file contains named frames for each asset + a single master component for pricing badges.
- Assets reviewed & approved by PM (Lina Chen) and Engineering owner (Priya Suresh).
- Localization hooks (copy keys) present for EN, ES, DE.
- A/B copy variants ready for the Growth experiment team to pick up.

Constraints & notes:
- Pricing numbers are placeholder until finance confirms final tiers (depends on PM-3980). For mockups use: $0.03 / 1k tokens for small models, $0.12 / 1k for large models. Markers must be easy to update.
- Deprecation messaging must include a one-click migration path link to avoid blocking support load (see ENG-1199 for auto-routing requirement).
- Keep overlays non-modal where possible to avoid blocking first-time workflows; modal is reserved for explicit migration confirmations.

Localization & A11y:
- Provide English copy variants and commentary for translators; final translations will be supplied by i18n later.
- Contrast ratios must meet WCAG AA for normal text and AAA for large text where applicable. Include a short accessibility note per asset.
screenshot_specs: Template sizes: main (1200x675 px export @2x saved as 2400x1350 PNG), narrow (680x384 px @2x), mobile frame (390x844 px @3x). Fonts: Inter 600/400 and Mono 400 for code snippets. Badges: token-cost badge (left) in #0B69FF, embargo badge (right) in #D64545. Export alt text and caption lines included in a CSV for release notes.
